purpose: Remove operational ambiguity in judge execution and intake without changing any screenplay bytes, blind mapping, pre-frozen sample, scoring axis, critical-violation label, gate, threshold, or claim boundary.
allowed_clarifications: Every numeric score placeholder 0 must be replaced with a number from 1.0 through 10.0 inclusive; integer or one decimal.
Every paired preference placeholder must be replaced by exactly A, B, or TIE.
Reconstruction arrays must mark every item with EVIDENCED: or INFERRED: while retaining the existing array fields.
Critical-violation arrays must use only the frozen labels and identify scene evidence; use [] when none.
Return one JSON object only: no Markdown fences, no prose before or after JSON.

Whole-episode scoring should be performed from the two complete scripts; the repeated pre-frozen sample block is for surface scoring and must not be counted as additional scenes in whole-episode judgment.

First complete schema-valid judgment is immutable. Only transport/UI encoding normalization may occur after receipt; no score, preference, evidence, reconstruction, strength, weakness, or critical-violation content may be edited.
forbidden_changes: judge identity or replacement after seeing an output
coordinator mapping reveal before 3/3 valid raw judgments are hash-sealed
